<script>
// ==========================================
// 螳壽焚螳夂ｾｩ & 繝・・繧ｿ逕滓・
// ==========================================
const NUM_STAFF = 50;
const NUM_DAYS = 28;
const WEEKDAYS = ['譛・, '轣ｫ', '豌ｴ', '譛ｨ', '驥・, '蝨・, '譌･'];

let staffList = [];
for (let i = 1; i <= NUM_STAFF; i++) {
    staffList.push({
        id: i,
        name: `繧ｹ繧ｿ繝・ヵ ${String(i).padStart(2, '0')}`,
        can8: (i <= 9),
        noEarly: false,
        noLate: false,
        noEve: false,
        prevDays: ['笳・, '笳・, '莨・, '笳・, '笳・],
        days: new Array(NUM_DAYS).fill('')
    });
}

function getTermInfo() {
    const dates = [];
    const startDate = new Date(2026, 3, 29); // 2026-04-29 (豌ｴ)
    for (let i = 0; i < NUM_DAYS; i++) {
        const d = new Date(startDate.getFullYear(), startDate.getMonth(), startDate.getDate() + i);
        const m = d.getMonth() + 1;
        const day = d.getDate();
        const wIdx = (d.getDay() + 6) % 7;
        dates.push({
            m,
            day,
            weekday: WEEKDAYS[wIdx],
            label: `${m}/${day}`,
            wIdx,
            dateObj: d
        });
    }
    const first = dates[0];
    const last = dates[NUM_DAYS - 1];
    const title = `${first.m}譛・{first.day}譌･・・{last.m}譛・{last.day}譌･蜍､蜍呵｡ｨ`;
    return { title, dates, first, last };
}

// CRC32
const zipCrcTable = new Uint32Array(256);
for (let n = 0; n < 256; n++) {
    let c = n;
    for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) {
        c = ((c & 1) ? (0xEDB88320 ^ (c >>> 1)) : (c >>> 1));
    }
    zipCrcTable[n] = c;
}
function calcZipCrc32(buf) {
    let crc = 0xFFFFFFFF;
    for (let i = 0; i < buf.length; i++) {
        crc = (crc >>> 8) ^ zipCrcTable[(crc ^ buf[i]) & 0xFF];
    }
    return (crc ^ 0xFFFFFFFF) >>> 0;
}

function createZipUint8Array(files) {
    const textEncoder = new TextEncoder();
    const fileEntries = files.map(f => {
        const nameBytes = textEncoder.encode(f.name);
        const dataBytes = (typeof f.data === 'string') ? textEncoder.encode(f.data) : f.data;
        return {
            name: f.name,
            nameBytes,
            dataBytes,
            crc: calcZipCrc32(dataBytes),
            size: dataBytes.length
        };
    });

    let localHeadersSize = 0;
    fileEntries.forEach(f => {
        f.offset = localHeadersSize;
        localHeadersSize += 30 + f.nameBytes.length + f.size;
    });

    let centralDirSize = 0;
    fileEntries.forEach(f => {
        centralDirSize += 46 + f.nameBytes.length;
    });

    const totalSize = localHeadersSize + centralDirSize + 22;
    const buf = new Uint8Array(totalSize);
    const view = new DataView(buf.buffer);
    let pos = 0;

    fileEntries.forEach(f => {
        view.setUint32(pos, 0x04034b50, true); pos += 4;
        view.setUint16(pos, 20, true); pos += 2;
        view.setUint16(pos, 0x0800, true); pos += 2;
        view.setUint16(pos, 0, true); pos += 2;
        view.setUint16(pos, 0x4a21, true); pos += 2;
        view.setUint16(pos, 0x5894, true); pos += 2;
        view.setUint32(pos, f.crc, true); pos += 4;
        view.setUint32(pos, f.size, true); pos += 4;
        view.setUint32(pos, f.size, true); pos += 4;
        view.setUint16(pos, f.nameBytes.length, true); pos += 2;
        view.setUint16(pos, 0, true); pos += 2;
        buf.set(f.nameBytes, pos); pos += f.nameBytes.length;
        buf.set(f.dataBytes, pos); pos += f.size;
    });

    const cdOffset = pos;
    fileEntries.forEach(f => {
        view.setUint32(pos, 0x02014b50, true); pos += 4;
        view.setUint16(pos, 20, true); pos += 2;
        view.setUint16(pos, 20, true); pos += 2;
        view.setUint16(pos, 0x0800, true); pos += 2;
        view.setUint16(pos, 0, true); pos += 2;
        view.setUint16(pos, 0x4a21, true); pos += 2;
        view.setUint16(pos, 0x5894, true); pos += 2;
        view.setUint32(pos, f.crc, true); pos += 4;
        view.setUint32(pos, f.size, true); pos += 4;
        view.setUint32(pos, f.size, true); pos += 4;
        view.setUint16(pos, f.nameBytes.length, true); pos += 2;
        view.setUint16(pos, 0, true); pos += 2;
        view.setUint16(pos, 0, true); pos += 2;
        view.setUint16(pos, 0, true); pos += 2;
        view.setUint16(pos, 0, true); pos += 2;
        view.setUint32(pos, 0, true); pos += 4;
        view.setUint32(pos, f.offset, true); pos += 4;
        buf.set(f.nameBytes, pos); pos += f.nameBytes.length;
    });

    view.setUint32(pos, 0x06054b50, true); pos += 4;
    view.setUint16(pos, 0, true); pos += 2;
    view.setUint16(pos, 0, true); pos += 2;
    view.setUint16(pos, fileEntries.length, true); pos += 2;
    view.setUint16(pos, fileEntries.length, true); pos += 2;
    view.setUint32(pos, centralDirSize, true); pos += 4;
    view.setUint32(pos, cdOffset, true); pos += 4;
    view.setUint16(pos, 0, true); pos += 2;

    return buf;
}

function toColLetter(colIdx) {
    let temp = colIdx;
    let letter = '';
    while (temp > 0) {
        let rem = (temp - 1) % 26;
        letter = String.fromCharCode(65 + rem) + letter;
        temp = Math.floor((temp - 1) / 26);
    }
    return letter;
}

// 1. 遨ｺ逋ｽ繝・Φ繝励Ξ繝ｼ繝・LSX縺ｮ逕滓・

  <Relationship Id="rId2" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/styles" Target="styles.xml"/>
</Relationships>`;

    const styles = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<styleSheet xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main">
  <fonts count="5">
    <font><sz val="10"/><color rgb="FF1E293B"/><name val="Meiryo"/></font>

  <fills count="6">

  </fills>
  <borders count="2">

    </border>
  </borders>
  <cellStyleXfs count="1"><xf numFmtId="0" fontId="0" fillId="0" borderId="0"/></cellStyleXfs>
  <cellXfs count="9">
    <xf numFmtId="0" fontId="0" fillId="0" borderId="0" xfId="0"/>
    <xf numFmtId="0" fontId="4" fillId="0" borderId="0" xfId="0"/>
    <xf numFmtId="0" fontId="1" fillId="2" borderId="1" xfId="0" applyFont="1" applyFill="1" applyBorder="1" applyAlignment="1"><alignment horizontal="center" vertical="center"/></xf>
    <xf numFmtId="0" fontId="2" fillId="3" borderId="1" xfId="0" applyFont="1" applyFill="1" applyBorder="1" applyAlignment="1"><alignment horizontal="center" vertical="center"/></xf>
    <xf numFmtId="0" fontId="3" fillId="4" borderId="1" xfId="0" applyFont="1" applyFill="1" applyBorder="1" applyAlignment="1"><alignment horizontal="center" vertical="center"/></xf>
    <xf numFmtId="0" fontId="0" fillId="0" borderId="1" xfId="0" applyFont="1" applyBorder="1" applyAlignment="1"><alignment horizontal="center" vertical="center"/></xf>
    <xf numFmtId="0" fontId="1" fillId="0" borderId="1" xfId="0" applyFont="1" applyBorder="1" applyAlignment="1"><alignment horizontal="left" vertical="center"/></xf>
    <xf numFmtId="0" fontId="1" fillId="5" borderId="1" xfId="0" applyFont="1" applyFill="1" applyBorder="1" applyAlignment="1"><alignment horizontal="center" vertical="center"/></xf>
    <xf numFmtId="0" fontId="0" fillId="0" borderId="1" xfId="0" applyFont="1" applyBorder="1" applyAlignment="1"><alignment horizontal="left" vertical="center"/></xf>
  </cellXfs>
</styleSheet>`;

    let ws = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<worksheet xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main">
  <dimension ref="A1:AG53"/>
  <sheetViews><sheetView tabSelected="1" workbookViewId="0"/></sheetViews>
  <sheetFormatPr defaultRowHeight="19"/>
  <cols>
    <col min="1" max="1" width="5.5" customWidth="1"/>
    <col min="2" max="2" width="13" customWidth="1"/>
    <col min="3" max="30" width="6" customWidth="1"/>
    <col min="31" max="32" width="10" customWidth="1"/>
    <col min="33" max="33" width="18" customWidth="1"/>
  </cols>
  <sheetData>
    <row r="1" ht="25">
      <c r="A1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>${title}</t></is></c>
    </row>
    <row r="2" ht="20">
      <c r="A2" s="2" t="inlineStr"><is><t>No</t></is></c>
      <c r="B2" s="2" t="inlineStr"><is><t>豌丞錐</t></is></c>
`;

    for (let d = 0; d < NUM_DAYS; d++) {
        const di = term.dates[d];
        const colLetter = toColLetter(d + 3);
        const styleId = di.wIdx === 5 ? 3 : (di.wIdx === 6 ? 4 : 2);
        ws += `      <c r="${colLetter}2" s="${styleId}" t="inlineStr"><is><t>${di.m}/${di.day}</t></is></c>\n`;
    }
    ws += `      <c r="AE2" s="2" t="inlineStr"><is><t>蟶梧悍莨第焚</t></is></c>
      <c r="AF2" s="2" t="inlineStr"><is><t>蟶梧悍譛我ｼ第焚</t></is></c>
      <c r="AG2" s="2" t="inlineStr"><is><t>蛯呵・/t></is></c>
    </row>
    <row r="3" ht="18">
      <c r="A3" s="2" t="inlineStr"><is><t></t></is></c>
      <c r="B3" s="2" t="inlineStr"><is><t></t></is></c>
`;

    for (let d = 0; d < NUM_DAYS; d++) {
        const di = term.dates[d];
        const colLetter = toColLetter(d + 3);
        const styleId = di.wIdx === 5 ? 3 : (di.wIdx === 6 ? 4 : 2);
        ws += `      <c r="${colLetter}3" s="${styleId}" t="inlineStr"><is><t>${di.weekday}</t></is></c>\n`;
    }
    ws += `      <c r="AE3" s="2" t="inlineStr"><is><t></t></is></c>
      <c r="AF3" s="2" t="inlineStr"><is><t></t></is></c>
      <c r="AG3" s="2" t="inlineStr"><is><t></t></is></c>
    </row>
`;

    for (let s = 0; s < NUM_STAFF; s++) {
        const r = s + 4;
        const staff = staffList[s];
        ws += `    <row r="${r}" ht="20">
      <c r="A${r}" s="7"><v>${staff.id}</v></c>
      <c r="B${r}" s="6" t="inlineStr"><is><t>${staff.name}</t></is></c>
`;
        for (let d = 0; d < NUM_DAYS; d++) {
            const colLetter = toColLetter(d + 3);
            ws += `      <c r="${colLetter}${r}" s="5"/>\n`;
        }

        const fOff = `COUNTIF(C${r}:AD${r},"莨・)+0.5*(COUNTIF(C${r}:AD${r},"笳・莨・)+COUNTIF(C${r}:AD${r},"莨・笳・))`;
        const fPaid = `COUNTIF(C${r}:AD${r},"譛・)+0.5*(COUNTIF(C${r}:AD${r},"笳・譛・)+COUNTIF(C${r}:AD${r},"譛・笳・))`;
        ws += `      <c r="AE${r}" s="5"><f>${fOff}</f></c>
      <c r="AF${r}" s="5"><f>${fPaid}</f></c>
      <c r="AG${r}" s="8"/>
    </row>
`;
    }

    ws += `  </sheetData>
  <dataValidations count="1">
    <dataValidation type="list" allowBlank="1" showInputMessage="1" showErrorMessage="1" sqref="C4:AD53">
      <formula1>&quot;笳・莨・譛・譌ｩ,驕・E,8譎・荳・,荳・,荳・,荳・,荳・,荳・,荳・,荳・,笳・莨・莨・笳・笳・譛・譛・笳・quot;</formula1>
    </dataValidation>
  </dataValidations>
</worksheet>`;

    const files = [
        { name: '[Content_Types].xml', data: contentTypes },
        { name: '_rels/.rels', data: rels },
        { name: 'xl/workbook.xml', data: workbook },
        { name: 'xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels', data: wbRels },
        { name: 'xl/styles.xml', data: styles },
        { name: 'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml', data: ws }
    ];

    return createZipUint8Array(files);
}

// 2. copyForExcel 縺ｮ HTML 逕滓・
function generateCopyForExcelHtml() {
    const term = getTermInfo();
    const startCol = 'C';
    const endCol = 'AD';
    const borderThin = 'border:0.5pt solid #cbd5e1;';
    const borderThickR = 'border-right:2pt solid #475569;';
    const borderMediumR = 'border-right:1.5pt solid #64748b;';
    const borderThickB = 'border-bottom:2pt solid #475569;';

    // 繧ｽ繝ｫ繝舌・螳溯｡・
    const scheduler = new ShiftScheduler(staffList, { standardHolidays: 8.0 });
    const result = scheduler.solve();
    const grid = result.grid;
    const stats = result.stats;

    let html = `<table style="border-collapse:collapse; font-family:'Meiryo',sans-serif; font-size:10pt; border:2pt solid #475569;">
<thead>
  <tr>
    <th rowspan="2" style="background-color:#f1f5f9; font-weight:bold; ${borderThin} ${borderThickB}">No</th>
    <th rowspan="2" style="background-color:#f1f5f9; font-weight:bold; ${borderThin} ${borderThickR} ${borderThickB}">豌丞錐</th>
    <th colspan="${NUM_DAYS}" style="background-color:#f8fafc; color:#1e293b; font-weight:bold; font-size:11pt; ${borderThin} ${borderThickR} ${borderThickB}">${term.title}・郁ｵ､蟄怜､ｪ蟄・ 莠句燕蟶梧悍譫 / 鮟貞ｭ・ 閾ｪ蜍暮・鄂ｮ・・/th>
    <th colspan="8" style="background-color:#e0f2fe; color:#0369a1; font-weight:bold; ${borderThin} ${borderThickB}">蜍､蜍吶・莨第嚊 髮・ｨ茨ｼ郁・蜍戊ｨ育ｮ玲焚蠑擾ｼ・/th>
  </tr>
  <tr>
`;

    for (let d = 0; d < NUM_DAYS; d++) {
        const dateInfo = term.dates[d];
        const bg = dateInfo.wIdx === 5 ? '#e0f2fe' : (dateInfo.wIdx === 6 ? '#ffe4e6' : '#f1f5f9');
        const col = dateInfo.wIdx === 5 ? '#0284c7' : (dateInfo.wIdx === 6 ? '#e11d48' : '#1e293b');
        const rightBorder = ((d + 1) === NUM_DAYS) ? borderThickR : (((d + 1) % 7 === 0) ? borderMediumR : '');
        html += `    <th style="background-color:${bg}; color:${col}; font-weight:bold; ${borderThin} ${rightBorder} ${borderThickB}">${dateInfo.label}<br><small>${dateInfo.weekday}</small></th>\n`;
    }

    html += `    <th style="background-color:#f1f5f9; font-weight:bold; ${borderThin} ${borderThickB}">蜃ｺ蜍､</th>
    <th style="background-color:#f1f5f9; color:#2563eb; font-weight:bold; ${borderThin} ${borderThickB}">蜈ｬ莨・/th>
    <th style="background-color:#fef3c7; color:#b45309; font-weight:bold; ${borderThin} ${borderThickB}">譛我ｼ・/th>
    <th style="background-color:#f1f5f9; color:#059669; font-weight:bold; ${borderThin} ${borderThickB}">繝ｪ繝・/th>
    <th style="background-color:#f1f5f9; font-weight:bold; ${borderThin} ${borderThickB}">譌ｩ</th>
    <th style="background-color:#f1f5f9; font-weight:bold; ${borderThin} ${borderThickB}">驕・/th>
    <th style="background-color:#f1f5f9; font-weight:bold; ${borderThin} ${borderThickB}">E</th>
    <th style="background-color:#f1f5f9; font-weight:bold; ${borderThin} ${borderThickB}">8譎・/th>
  </tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
`;

    for (let s = 0; s < NUM_STAFF; s++) {
        const staff = staffList[s];
        const rowNum = s + 3;
        const isLastStaff = (s === NUM_STAFF - 1);
        const rowBottom = isLastStaff ? borderThickB : '';
        const rng = `${startCol}${rowNum}:${endCol}${rowNum}`;

        const fWork = `=COUNTIF(${rng},"笳・)+COUNTIF(${rng},"蜃ｺ")+COUNTIF(${rng},"譌ｩ")+COUNTIF(${rng},"驕・)+COUNTIF(${rng},"E")+COUNTIF(${rng},"8譎・)+0.5*(COUNTIF(${rng},"笳・莨・)+COUNTIF(${rng},"莨・笳・)+COUNTIF(${rng},"笳・譛・)+COUNTIF(${rng},"譛・笳・))`;
        const fOff = `=COUNTIF(${rng},"莨・)+0.5*(COUNTIF(${rng},"笳・莨・)+COUNTIF(${rng},"莨・笳・))`;
        const fPaid = `=COUNTIF(${rng},"譛・)+0.5*(COUNTIF(${rng},"笳・譛・)+COUNTIF(${rng},"譛・笳・))`;
        const fRef = `=COUNTIF(${rng},"荳・")+COUNTIF(${rng},"荳・")+COUNTIF(${rng},"荳・")+COUNTIF(${rng},"荳・")+COUNTIF(${rng},"荳・")+COUNTIF(${rng},"荳・")+COUNTIF(${rng},"荳・")+COUNTIF(${rng},"荳・")`;
        const fEarly = `=COUNTIF(${rng},"譌ｩ")`;
        const fLate = `=COUNTIF(${rng},"驕・)`;
        const fEve = `=COUNTIF(${rng},"E")`;
        const fH8 = `=COUNTIF(${rng},"8譎・)`;

        html += `  <tr>\n`;
        html += `    <td style="font-weight:bold; ${borderThin} ${rowBottom} text-align:center;">${staff.id}</td>\n`;
        html += `    <td style="font-weight:bold; ${borderThin} ${borderThickR} ${rowBottom} text-align:left;">${staff.name}</td>\n`;

        for (let d = 0; d < NUM_DAYS; d++) {
            const cell = grid[s][d];
            const rightBorder = ((d + 1) === NUM_DAYS) ? borderThickR : (((d + 1) % 7 === 0) ? borderMediumR : '');
            if (cell.isFixed) {
                html += `    <td style="color:#DC2626 !important; font-weight:bold !important; ${borderThin} ${rightBorder} ${rowBottom} text-align:center;"><b style="color:#DC2626;">${cell.symbol}</b></td>\n`;
            } else {
                html += `    <td style="${borderThin} ${rightBorder} ${rowBottom} text-align:center;">${cell.symbol}</td>\n`;
            }
        }

        const staffStat = (stats.staffStats && stats.staffStats[s]) ? stats.staffStats[s] : { workDays: 0, offDays: 0, paidDays: 0, refDays: 0, early: 0, late: 0, eve: 0, h8: 0 };

        html += `    <td style="font-weight:bold; ${borderThin} ${rowBottom} text-align:center;" x:num="${staffStat.workDays}" x:f="${fWork}">${staffStat.workDays}</td>\n`;
        html += `    <td style="font-weight:bold; color:#2563eb; ${borderThin} ${rowBottom} text-align:center;" x:num="${staffStat.offDays}" x:f="${fOff}">${staffStat.offDays}</td>\n`;
        html += `    <td style="font-weight:bold; color:#b45309; background-color:#fef3c7; ${borderThin} ${rowBottom} text-align:center;" x:num="${staffStat.paidDays}" x:f="${fPaid}">${staffStat.paidDays}</td>\n`;
        html += `    <td style="font-weight:bold; color:#059669; ${borderThin} ${rowBottom} text-align:center;" x:num="${staffStat.refDays}" x:f="${fRef}">${staffStat.refDays}</td>\n`;
        html += `    <td style="${borderThin} ${rowBottom} text-align:center;" x:num="${staffStat.early}" x:f="${fEarly}">${staffStat.early}</td>\n`;
        html += `    <td style="${borderThin} ${rowBottom} text-align:center;" x:num="${staffStat.late}" x:f="${fLate}">${staffStat.late}</td>\n`;
        html += `    <td style="${borderThin} ${rowBottom} text-align:center;" x:num="${staffStat.eve}" x:f="${fEve}">${staffStat.eve}</td>\n`;
        html += `    <td style="${borderThin} ${rowBottom} text-align:center;" x:num="${staffStat.h8}" x:f="${fH8}">${staffStat.h8}</td>\n`;
        html += `  </tr>\n`;
    }

    html += `</tbody>\n<tfoot>\n`;
    const startRow = 3;
    const endRow = NUM_STAFF + 2;

    // 1. 54陦檎岼: 蜃ｺ蜍､莠ｺ謨ｰ蜷郁ｨ・
    html += `  <tr style="background-color:#f8fafc; font-weight:bold;">\n`;
    html += `    <th colspan="2" style="${borderThin} ${borderThickR} border-bottom:1pt solid #64748b; text-align:center;">蜃ｺ蜍､莠ｺ謨ｰ蜷郁ｨ茨ｼ遺雷繝ｻ迚ｹ谿翫・蜊頑律・・/th>\n`;
    for (let d = 0; d < NUM_DAYS; d++) {
        const col = toColLetter(d + 3);
        const colRng = `${col}${startRow}:${col}${endRow}`;
        const rightBorder = ((d + 1) === NUM_DAYS) ? borderThickR : (((d + 1) % 7 === 0) ? borderMediumR : '');
        const fDayWork = `=COUNTIF(${colRng},"笳・)+COUNTIF(${colRng},"蜃ｺ")+COUNTIF(${colRng},"譌ｩ")+COUNTIF(${colRng},"驕・)+COUNTIF(${colRng},"E")+COUNTIF(${colRng},"8譎・)+0.5*(COUNTIF(${colRng},"笳・莨・)+COUNTIF(${colRng},"莨・笳・)+COUNTIF(${colRng},"笳・譛・)+COUNTIF(${colRng},"譛・笳・))`;
        const val = stats.daily ? stats.daily[d].totalWork : '';
        html += `    <td style="font-weight:bold; ${borderThin} ${rightBorder} border-bottom:1pt solid #64748b; text-align:center;" x:num="${val}" x:f="${fDayWork}">${val}</td>\n`;
    }
    const sumWork = `=SUM(AE${startRow}:AE${endRow})`;
    const sumOff  = `=SUM(AF${startRow}:AF${endRow})`;
    const sumPaid = `=SUM(AG${startRow}:AG${endRow})`;
    const sumRef  = `=SUM(AH${startRow}:AH${endRow})`;
    const sumEarly = `=SUM(AI${startRow}:AI${endRow})`;
    const sumLate  = `=SUM(AJ${startRow}:AJ${endRow})`;
    const sumEve   = `=SUM(AK${startRow}:AK${endRow})`;
    const sumH8    = `=SUM(AL${startRow}:AL${endRow})`;

    html += `    <td style="font-weight:bold; ${borderThin} border-bottom:1pt solid #64748b; text-align:center;" x:f="${sumWork}">${sumWork}</td>\n`;
    html += `    <td style="font-weight:bold; color:#2563eb; ${borderThin} border-bottom:1pt solid #64748b; text-align:center;" x:f="${sumOff}">${sumOff}</td>\n`;
    html += `    <td style="font-weight:bold; color:#b45309; background-color:#fef3c7; ${borderThin} border-bottom:1pt solid #64748b; text-align:center;" x:f="${sumPaid}">${sumPaid}</td>\n`;
    html += `    <td style="font-weight:bold; color:#059669; ${borderThin} border-bottom:1pt solid #64748b; text-align:center;" x:f="${sumRef}">${sumRef}</td>\n`;
    html += `    <td style="${borderThin} border-bottom:1pt solid #64748b; text-align:center;" x:f="${sumEarly}">${sumEarly}</td>\n`;
    html += `    <td style="${borderThin} border-bottom:1pt solid #64748b; text-align:center;" x:f="${sumLate}">${sumLate}</td>\n`;
    html += `    <td style="${borderThin} border-bottom:1pt solid #64748b; text-align:center;" x:f="${sumEve}">${sumEve}</td>\n`;
    html += `    <td style="${borderThin} border-bottom:1pt solid #64748b; text-align:center;" x:f="${sumH8}">${sumH8}</td>\n`;
    html += `  </tr>\n`;

    // 2. 55陦檎岼: 譌ｩ逡ｪ
    html += `  <tr style="background-color:#fff7ed; font-weight:bold; font-size:9pt;">\n`;
    html += `    <th colspan="2" style="color:#c2410c; ${borderThin} ${borderThickR} border-bottom:0.5pt solid #cbd5e1; text-align:center;">譌ｩ逡ｪ</th>\n`;
    for (let d = 0; d < NUM_DAYS; d++) {
        const col = toColLetter(d + 3);
        const colRng = `${col}${startRow}:${col}${endRow}`;
        const rightBorder = ((d + 1) === NUM_DAYS) ? borderThickR : (((d + 1) % 7 === 0) ? borderMediumR : '');
        const fDayEarly = `=COUNTIF(${colRng},"譌ｩ")`;
        const val = stats.daily ? stats.daily[d].early : '';
        html += `    <td style="color:#c2410c; ${borderThin} ${rightBorder} border-bottom:0.5pt solid #cbd5e1; text-align:center;" x:num="${val}" x:f="${fDayEarly}">${val}</td>\n`;
    }
    html += `    <td colspan="8" style="${borderThin} border-bottom:0.5pt solid #cbd5e1; text-align:center; color:#94a3b8;">-</td>\n  </tr>\n`;

    // 3. 56陦檎岼: 驕・分
    html += `  <tr style="background-color:#f0f9ff; font-weight:bold; font-size:9pt;">\n`;
    html += `    <th colspan="2" style="color:#0369a1; ${borderThin} ${borderThickR} border-bottom:0.5pt solid #cbd5e1; text-align:center;">驕・分</th>\n`;
    for (let d = 0; d < NUM_DAYS; d++) {
        const col = toColLetter(d + 3);
        const colRng = `${col}${startRow}:${col}${endRow}`;
        const rightBorder = ((d + 1) === NUM_DAYS) ? borderThickR : (((d + 1) % 7 === 0) ? borderMediumR : '');
        const fDayLate = `=COUNTIF(${colRng},"驕・)`;
        const val = stats.daily ? stats.daily[d].late : '';
        html += `    <td style="color:#0369a1; ${borderThin} ${rightBorder} border-bottom:0.5pt solid #cbd5e1; text-align:center;" x:num="${val}" x:f="${fDayLate}">${val}</td>\n`;
    }
    html += `    <td colspan="8" style="${borderThin} border-bottom:0.5pt solid #cbd5e1; text-align:center; color:#94a3b8;">-</td>\n  </tr>\n`;

    // 4. 57陦檎岼: E
    html += `  <tr style="background-color:#faf5ff; font-weight:bold; font-size:9pt;">\n`;
    html += `    <th colspan="2" style="color:#7e22ce; ${borderThin} ${borderThickR} border-bottom:0.5pt solid #cbd5e1; text-align:center;">E</th>\n`;
    for (let d = 0; d < NUM_DAYS; d++) {
        const col = toColLetter(d + 3);
        const colRng = `${col}${startRow}:${col}${endRow}`;
        const rightBorder = ((d + 1) === NUM_DAYS) ? borderThickR : (((d + 1) % 7 === 0) ? borderMediumR : '');
        const fDayEve = `=COUNTIF(${colRng},"E")`;
        const val = stats.daily ? stats.daily[d].eve : '';
        html += `    <td style="color:#7e22ce; ${borderThin} ${rightBorder} border-bottom:0.5pt solid #cbd5e1; text-align:center;" x:num="${val}" x:f="${fDayEve}">${val}</td>\n`;
    }
    html += `    <td colspan="8" style="${borderThin} border-bottom:0.5pt solid #cbd5e1; text-align:center; color:#94a3b8;">-</td>\n  </tr>\n`;

    // 5. 58陦檎岼: 8譎・
    html += `  <tr style="background-color:#f0fdfa; font-weight:bold; font-size:9pt;">\n`;
    html += `    <th colspan="2" style="color:#0f766e; ${borderThin} ${borderThickR} ${borderThickB} text-align:center;">8譎・/th>\n`;
    for (let d = 0; d < NUM_DAYS; d++) {
        const col = toColLetter(d + 3);
        const colRng = `${col}${startRow}:${col}${endRow}`;
        const rightBorder = ((d + 1) === NUM_DAYS) ? borderThickR : (((d + 1) % 7 === 0) ? borderMediumR : '');
        const fDayH8 = `=COUNTIF(${colRng},"8譎・)`;
        const val = stats.daily ? stats.daily[d].h8 : '';
        html += `    <td style="color:#0f766e; ${borderThin} ${rightBorder} ${borderThickB} text-align:center;" x:num="${val}" x:f="${fDayH8}">${val}</td>\n`;
    }
    html += `    <td colspan="8" style="${borderThin} ${borderThickB} text-align:center; color:#94a3b8;">-</td>\n  </tr>\n</tfoot>\n</table>`;

    return html;
}

// 螳溯｡後→蜃ｺ蜉・
try {
    const xlsxBytes = generateBlankXlsxBytes();
    let binary = '';
    const len = xlsxBytes.byteLength;
    for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        binary += String.fromCharCode(xlsxBytes[i]);
    }
    const xlsxB64 = btoa(binary);
    document.getElementById('xlsx-b64').innerText = xlsxB64;

    const copyHtml = generateCopyForExcelHtml();
    document.getElementById('copy-html').innerText = copyHtml;

    document.getElementById('test-status').innerText = 'SUCCESS_GENERATE';
} catch (e) {
    document.getElementById('test-status').innerText = 'ERROR: ' + e.message;
}
</script>


</body></html>
